_comment: data-analysis scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A chat model is all you need. The embed model is OPTIONAL -- it powers
search_docs over a dataset's documentation (a data dictionary, a codebook);
delete it if you have none. Point at a local model (LM Studio / llama.cpp /
Ollama) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md.
snapshots let you /undo a bad edit to a script; pathFence keeps file writes
inside your workspace so your raw data elsewhere is never touched.
